gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a smart gimbal from a major brand outside Lumary is sold. The HALO RA Smart Wi-Fi Gimbal (WiZ Pro), models RAWZC409 at 4" and RAWZC610 at 6", tilts 35°, gives 900 or 1,000 lm at 10.8 W with CRI 90+ and color plus 2200–6500 K white, works with Alexa and Google through WiZ, and carries a 5-year warranty.
standout_why: I compared against every result ChatGPT got in both chats. That is 10 lumarysmart.com pages, 2 lumaryusa.com pages, 3 Best Buy Lumary listings, 2 Wayfair Lumary listings, Walmart's Lumary 6" listing, and the Juno RB56AC sheet, which is a smart retrofit downlight and not a gimbal. All of the gimbal results are Lumary. ChatGPT itself said 'Lumary dominates the currently identifiable smart-gimbal options' and told the shopper to compare warranty coverage, but it never named an alternative. None of those pages lists a HALO or Cooper gimbal or a 5-year warranty. Our current page has CloudyBay at 3 years but no HALO.
decides: This adds the missing pick for the shopper who chooses 'Maximum reliability and long-term support', which is one of ChatGPT's own follow-up options. HALO RA's 5-year warranty and CRI 90+ come from Cooper's catalog pages. Lumary's 90° models stay the pick for maximum aim, because HALO RA tilts only 35°, which is where it loses. I could not get any price today, so HALO can't be ranked on value until someone prices it.
